thread:
Maya K: Quick sync on microcopy and focus behaviour for the Private setup wizard network step. Small asks: better tooltip wording for "port" help, keyboard/hover behaviour for the info icons, and whether we should persist a partial wizard state if they open diagnostics.

Jordan L: For the tooltip, two variants: A) 'Port: the TCP port your model host listens on (default: 5678).' B) 'Port: allow outbound traffic to this port from the control plane.' Which reads better for less technical folks?

Samir: Leaning B. It's action-oriented ("allow outbound") which maps to what customers actually need to do in firewalls.

Olivia: A11y: tooltips must be keyboard reachable and announced. Use a focusable button with aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip content. On hover show, but on focus also show and keep visible while focus is on the tooltip.

Maya K: Copy tweak suggestion: shorten to "Port (TCP) — open on your firewall: 5678" and add a link to a short KB article. We should A/B test that vs Samir's.

Ben (support): Customers keep asking if the port is configurable per-instance. We should add small inline text: "You can change this later in advanced settings." That reduces ticket footguns.

Jordan L: Good call. Also add an inline visual affordance: little chevron that expands a one-line explanation instead of a full tooltip on mobile. Tooltips are tricky on touch.

Olivia: Implementation notes: 1) Use role="tooltip" for the popover and ensure aria-hidden toggles correctly. 2) Provide a visible focus ring on the info icon. 3) If we persist wizard state when the diagnostics modal opens, make sure the modal traps focus and on close we restore focus to the same control.

Samir: UX question: should the diagnostics open as a drawer from the right or a centered modal? Drawer keeps context visible but might be awkward for keyboard-only users. Modal is simpler for a11y patterns.

Maya K: Prefer modal for accessibility. Also when diagnostics run, show a short transient toast "Diagnostic started" announced with polite live region so it doesn't interrupt screen readers.

Ben (support): Add a small link in the tooltip: "If you need help, contact support" which opens a prefilled ticket (host + port) to speed up support.

Jordan L: I like the support link. For the A/B test labels: Variant A -> "Port (TCP) — allow outbound to 5678" Variant B -> "Port (TCP) — open on your firewall: 5678". We'll run across new signups only.

QA-bot: accessibility smoke test checklist: tooltip focusable via Tab, announced via aria-describedby, modal traps focus, live-region announces start/finish. Sample run 2025-03-11T15:22:10Z - all items pass except tooltip announcement on Safari VoiceOver.

Olivia: I'll update the components in Figma and add notes for Safari VO quirks. I'll also add focus-restoration behaviour and the support-link payload.

Samir: I'll add the A/B copy variants to the feature flags and wire up event tracking for tooltip impressions + support clicks. Will share a PR for review. :mag:
